description: CONVERGENCE AND SPECIAL SUPPORT PROGRAM, SUSTAINABLE INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS ALLEVIATING GAPS (SIPAG), ACCESS ROADS AND/OR BRIDGES FROM THE NATIONAL ROAD/S LEADING TO MAJOR/STRATEGIC PUBLIC BUILDING/FACILITIES, CONSTRUCTION OF LIPA CITY - MATAASNAKAHOY DI
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Newington Builders, Inc.(for: E. Gardiola Construc (winning bidder)

bidders.name: Newington Builders, Inc.(for: E. Gardiola Construc

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: NEWINGTON BUILDERS, INC.(FOR: E. GARDIOLA CONSTRUC: documented link to Edwin Gardiola (House representative, Construction Workers Solidarity (CWS) party-list): ICI and DPWH recommended criminal and administrative cases to the Ombudsman against eight lawmakers whose or whose families' firms won DPWH contracts (about 1,300 projects, 2016-20 [recommended, 2025-11-26; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: Total budget above 95% of similar works (length not stated)
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱193.0M; the 95th percentile for Access / tourism road is ₱120.6M (1064 past contracts).
reasons.evidence: Used only when the length cannot be read; a weak sign.
checks: Find the length or quantities in the bid documents and compute the price per km.
Check whether the scope (several roads, bridges, drainage) explains the size.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Newington Builders, Inc.(for: E. Gardiola Construc (winner): 3 of 173 earlier road contracts terminated; C.T. Leoncio Construction & Trading: 1 of 207 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: NEWINGTON BUILDERS, INC.(FOR: E. GARDIOLA CONSTRUC has 2 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

tests.text: NEWINGTON BUILDERS, INC.(FOR: E. GARDIOLA CONSTRUC: linked person Edwin Gardiola is on the OpenSanctions PEP list
